## 结果

在此撰写结果。

如图 \ref{fig-mtcars} 与表 \ref{tbl-mtcars} 所示，可直观查看 mtcars 数据的关系与摘要。

```{r}
#| label: fig-mtcars-gen
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| results: hide
library(ggplot2)
p <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = wt, y = mpg)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE)
input_path <- knitr::current_input()
root_dir <- normalizePath(file.path(dirname(input_path), ".."))
fig_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "fig")
if (!dir.exists(fig_dir)) dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE)
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "mtcars-ggplot2.pdf"), p, width = 5.5, height = 3.8)
```

```{=latex}
\begin{figure}[htbp]
\centering
\includegraphics[width=0.75\linewidth]{fig/mtcars-ggplot2.pdf}
\bicaption{mtcars 数据的 mpg 与 wt 关系}{MTCARS: mpg vs wt}
\label{fig-mtcars}
\end{figure}
```

```{r}
#| label: mtcars-table-gen
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| results: hide
input_path <- knitr::current_input()
root_dir <- normalizePath(file.path(dirname(input_path), ".."))
tex_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "tex", "generated")
if (!dir.exists(tex_dir)) dir.create(tex_dir, recursive = TRUE)
tbl_path <- file.path(tex_dir, "mtcars-table.tex")
tbl <- knitr::kable(head(mtcars, 6), format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE)
lines <- c(
  "\\begin{table}[htbp]",
  "\\centering",
  "\\bicaption{mtcars 数据前 6 行}{First 6 rows of mtcars}",
  "\\label{tbl-mtcars}",
  tbl,
  "\\end{table}"
)
writeLines(lines, tbl_path)
```

```{=latex}
\input{tex/generated/mtcars-table.tex}
```
